Name: Fiber and Cavecarrot Seeds
Author: zirolive69
Description:
This Mod add Fiber and Cavecarrot Seeds.


He is a stand alone version form the seeds in my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5112]"(PFM) Sapling Mashine"[/url] mod.

It adds fiber seeds for spring to fall and cavecarrot seeds for in door.

This Mod is in englisch,  chinese  and german.


[u][b]Installation:[/b][/u]

1. Install Smapi
2. Install Json Assets
3. Install this Mod
﻿unzip the Data and Copy it under\Stardew Valley\Mods\
[b][u]
optional:[/u][/b]

4.Install Mail framework Mod


[u][b]Deinstallion:

[/b][/u]only delete the folder and the object´s in the game.





[b]!!Importent!![/b]
This Mod is compatible with him [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5112]"(PFM) Sapling Mashine"[/url], but I use only one.
